task.description: Implement OBS-04 backend functionality for GET /instances/:id/timeline as specified in src/design/obs-04-instance-timeline.md. Add/modify API route, service/query layer, and response serialization to return ascending chronological timeline entries with required fields (event_type, timestamp, actor_display_name with system fallback, description, and relevant context fields). Enforce any-authenticated-role access, API-06 pagination semantics, and HTTP 404 for missing instances. Ensure archived events are included (ES-07 behavior) and CANCELLED instances include complete history including INSTANCE_CANCELLED. Integrate actor display-name resolution using existing identity data from IDN-01. Add or update migrations only if strictly required by design. Keep security constraints (prepared statements, no secret leakage) and module error-set correctness. Run full backend validation sequence and complete handoff with PASS/FAIL plus artifacts and issues.
acceptance_criteria: GET /instances/:id/timeline implemented with 200/404 behavior and authenticated-role access
Timeline entries are returned in ascending chronological order with all required OBS-04 fields
Pagination behavior conforms to API-06 and is deterministic across pages
Archived events and CANCELLED-instance history behavior are implemented per requirement
zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, and error-set validation complete successfully

result.summary: Implemented OBS-04 backend timeline endpoint support for GET /instances/:id/timeline with deterministic API-06 pagination, archived-event inclusion, actor display-name resolution from identity data with fallback, and required response fields/context. Added handler validation tests and wired endpoint authorization and OpenAPI listing. Mandatory backend validations completed: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate (with BPM_DB_URL), and error-set check clean.
